segments.name: Banking services
segments.description: Provides lending, depository, insurance and other banking services to consumers, businesses, and commercial real estate owners and developers.
segments.evidence: As the Company manages its business and operations on a consolidated basis, management has determined that there is one operating and one reportable business segment.

revenueModel.text: Borrowers pay the bank interest on loans, its principal source of revenue, alongside interest and dividends on investments.
revenueModel.evidence: WaFd's principal sources of revenue are interest on loans and interest and dividends on investments.

changes.text: In 2025 the bank stopped originating consumer single-family home loans and home equity lines of credit.
changes.evidence: In January, 2025, the Bank announced it will no longer originate consumer single family home loans and home equity lines of credit.
